mode_pane_title: Watch or take over just the selected pane (the pane on the computer is laid out for this panel)
mode_full_title: Like herdr on the computer: the sidebar, tabs and splits are all here to switch and use
pref_hint: Which view a newly opened terminal uses. The switch in the terminal header changes it any time.
end_forbidden: This device can only watch, so the full view isn't available
end_unsupported: Persona or herdr on this computer doesn't support the full view
end_limit: Too many full views are open. Close one elsewhere first
live_hint: herdr's own client. While you work here, the panes on the computer are laid out for this panel's size; they switch back when you return to the computer
fallback: The full view couldn't open: {why}. Using a single pane instead
load_failed: The terminal component didn't load. Refresh the page and try again
hub_unsupported: This hub doesn't support the full view
hint_toast: The full view is herdr's own client. While you work here, the panes on the computer are laid out for this panel's size; they switch back when you return to the computer.
clipboard_https: This page can't read the clipboard (it needs HTTPS). Paste with ⌘V / Ctrl+V
clipboard_denied: The browser didn't allow reading the clipboard. Paste with ⌘V / Ctrl+V
select_first_herdr: Select the text to copy with the mouse first (text selected in herdr copies itself)
select_first: Select the text to copy with the mouse first
copy_prompt: herdr wants to copy some text
paste_not_live: Wait until the full view is connected to paste files
paste_changed: The terminal changed during the upload, so nothing was pasted
paste_released: The full view disconnected during the upload, so nothing was pasted
elsewhere_hint: herdr's focus was moved to another pane from elsewhere (the computer's window or another browser). Click to follow it here
